title: MAIN THEME EPISODE 13: THE WHIRLPOOL THAT IS PASSION OPEN
lines: 01 MAIN THEME EPISODE 13: THE WHIRLPOOL THAT IS PASSION OPEN
OPENS AT: April 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear 12-21 in the Main Theme Episode 12: All Quiet Under the Thunder
[ The Happy Windermere Family ]
OPENS AT: April 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: By clearing stages of Main Theme: The Whirlpool that is Passion in different environments, you can unlock the content of The Happy Windermere Family and obtain the corresponding rewards.
Reward: Main Theme Bonus Operator [★★★★★: Delphine], Delphine's Tokens, icon 'Whirlpool of Colossal Remains', Plaque - Ark, Plaque - Thirst, Elite Materials, LMD, etc.
02 THE WHIRLPOOL THAT IS PASSION ENCOURAGE EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, fail to challenge uncleared stages in The Whirlpool that is Passion will refund all Sanity consumed.
03 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – FROM GLEAMS AND SMOKE I EMERGE

DURATION: April 16, 2024, 10:00 - April 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7) DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [From Gleams And Smoke I Emerge], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★：Hoederer
★★★★★：Vendela / Kafka
★★★★：Verdant

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
04 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game. ★★★★★★: Hoederer ★★★★★: Vendela ★★★★★: Delphine ★★★★: Verdant

NOTE: - New Operator Delphine can only be obtained from The Happy Windermere Family in Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- After the From Gleams And Smoke I Emerge ends, Hoederer, Vendela, and Verdant will become available in other Standard Headhuntings after April 30, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- During April 16, 2024, 10:00 - April 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operator Hoederer, Vendela, Delphine, and Verdant will gain more Trust from all stages that consume Sanity (except Annihilation, Intermezzi, and Side Story stages).
05 LIMITED-TIME TACTICAL SUPPORT EVENT - PHRASE II

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by clearing stages in 'Main Theme' and Supplies stages to obtain Milestone Fragments and rewards, including new Home Screen UI, Emergency Sanity Sampler, Rhodes Island Supplies VI, etc; players can complete missions in [Support Memo] to obtain rewards, including Emergency Sanity Booster, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Milestone Fragments etc. Furthermore, all Operators will earn more Trust in Main Theme stages and Supplies stages after certain requirement being met; certain Operators can receive additional Trust boosts. The two effects can stack.
NOTE：
The Emergency Sanity Booster and the Emergency Sanity Concentrate gained from this event will expire on May 20, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7).
Increase your Milestone bonus by progressing through Main Theme stages during the event period.
Players who have met the requirements of the [Support Memo] missions before the event can receive the rewards directly after the event opens.

During the event, players can unlock Trust boost for Operators after clearing 11-4 under any Environment; players who have already cleared 11-4 before the event can directly gain the effect. After new Episode opens, players can unlock the additional Trust boost after clearing 13-1 under any Environment.
After Phrase II opens, the following Operators will gain more trust during the event: Hoederer, Vendela, Delphine, and Verdant.
The mentioned Trust-up effect stacks with the "New Operators Trust-up" bonus.
06 [Witch Feast] SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: April 16, 2024, 10:00 - April 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7) DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
[Witch Feast] Series - Hand of Destiny for Dorothy
[Witch Feast] Series - Divine Oath for Fiammetta
[Witch Feast] Series - The Bard's Tale for Quercus
[Witch Feast] Series - Priory of Abyss for Whisperain
07[Witch Feast] & [Shining Steps] SERIES , RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
[Witch Feast] Series - Trust Your Eyes for Lee
[Witch Feast] Series - Mirror Visitor for Iris
[Witch Feast] Series - Like Illusion for Kazemaru
[Shining Steps] Series - Publicity Strategy for Archetto
[Shining Steps] Series - Frlibe on the Palace for Astesia
08 NEW FURNITURE SET MERCENARIES' HIDEOUT
09 CHIP PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMTIED TIME
DETAILS: During the events, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
【GUARD CHIP PACK】
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Gard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
10 HOME SCREEN UI CHANGE FEATURE NOW AVAILABLE, NEW UI FOR FREE
Date： April 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)

Details: Home Screen UI change feature is now available. Doctors who reach level 50 can unlock the new UI "Night". The UI can be viewed in the feature. Please refer to the official introduction for more details.
Please stay tuned for more information!
